questions.feedback: That trap answer is the one to unlearn: A ratio of 3:2 means 3/2 of the whole. Reteach point: The whole is 5 parts, so 3 parts is 3 fifths of the whole. One part is $48 / 5 = $9.60, so 3 parts is $28.80.

questions.feedback: Scene s1 and s2 fix the fraction: the whole is 5 parts, so 3 parts is 3 out of 5 - 3/5 of the whole.
questions.prompt: 3 parts out of a whole of 5 parts is what fraction of the whole?

questions.answer: $72 is more than the whole $48: the whole is 5 parts, so 3 parts is 3/5 of $48, which is $28.80.
